question: How much land area in square kilometers is covered if you draw a 50 kilometer buffer around every world city and merge the overlapping zones?
sql: WITH cities AS (SELECT ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true) AS geom FROM populated_places WHERE is_world_city = true), buffered AS (SELECT ST_Buffer(geom,50000) AS geom FROM cities) SELECT ROUND(ST_Area(ST_Union_Agg(geom))/1000000.0,2) AS area_km2 FROM buffered;

question: For Zambia, how many square kilometers of its territory are at least 100 kilometers away from any populated place?
sql: WITH country AS (SELECT ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true) AS geom FROM countries WHERE name_long='Zambia'), buffer_union AS (SELECT ST_Union_Agg(ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true),100000)) AS geom FROM populated_places WHERE country='Zambia') SELECT ROUND(ST_Area(ST_Difference((SELECT geom FROM country), ST_Intersection((SELECT geom FROM country),(SELECT geom FROM buffer_union))))/1000000.0,2) AS remote_area_km2;

question: If you stretch a rubber band around all towns in Brazil, how big is the area inside in square kilometers?
sql: WITH pts AS (SELECT ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true) AS geom FROM populated_places WHERE country='Brazil') SELECT ROUND(ST_Area(ST_ConvexHull(ST_Union_Agg(geom)))/1000000.0,2) AS hull_area_km2 FROM pts;

question: Which country has its capital the farthest away from the country's geographic center, and how far is it in kilometers?
sql: WITH country_centroids AS (SELECT c.iso_a2, c.name_long, ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(c.geometry),'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true) AS cgeom FROM countries c), capitals AS (SELECT p.iso_a2, ST_Transform(p.geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true) AS pgeom FROM populated_places p WHERE p.is_capital = true) SELECT cc.name_long AS country, ROUND(ST_Distance(cc.cgeom, ca.pgeom)/1000.0,2) AS distance_km FROM country_centroids cc JOIN capitals ca ON cc.iso_a2 = ca.iso_a2 ORDER BY distance_km DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How much area in square kilometers is covered by the overlapping 100 kilometer buffer zones around the capitals of the Netherlands and Belgium?
sql: WITH netherlands AS (SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true),100000) AS geom FROM populated_places WHERE is_capital=true AND country='Netherlands'), belgium AS (SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true),100000) AS geom FROM populated_places WHERE is_capital=true AND country='Belgium') SELECT ROUND(ST_Area(ST_Intersection((SELECT geom FROM netherlands),(SELECT geom FROM belgium)))/1000000.0,2) AS overlap_km2;

question: What is the area in square kilometers of Russia after removing a 200 kilometer buffer around Moscow?
sql: WITH russia AS (SELECT ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true) AS geom FROM countries WHERE name_long='Russia'), moscow_buf AS (SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true),200000) AS geom FROM populated_places WHERE name='Moscow' AND country='Russia') SELECT ROUND(ST_Area(ST_Difference((SELECT geom FROM russia),(SELECT geom FROM moscow_buf)))/1000000.0,2) AS remaining_area_km2;
